verdict.reason: Continue with a bounded next-stage validation: THX-01 scored 22/24 on this synthetic NLP diagnostic versus 14/24 for the deliberately weak rules baseline, while scoring 2/8 on the game cases versus rules at 8/8. This supports an additional NLP task check and an explicit rules replacement for game decisions; it does not support general adoption. The tiny synthetic fixture, dependent variants, and weak baseline do not establish a large effect or generalization. The two supplied independent signals (the evaluation discussion and a derivative-model implementer) plus the primary model justify deeper review, but they are not separate validations of Japanese quality.

evidence.quote: Synthetic diagnostic, 12 unique NLP situations each clean/noisy and 4 game states each prose/JSON; variants are not independent samples.
The library made this much easier.
number, excerpt and citations are native THX-01 capabilities.

verdict.next_check: Validate additional NLP tasks using independent, gold-labeled inputs beyond this fixture, then separately test the number/excerpt/citation extraction utility on its intended documents. Keep game decisions on explicit rules unless they are independently revalidated.
